what.value: Idea to give voxterm a queue across sessions so gists from several agent sessions are spoken in turn at a steadier combined pace.
what.quote: Give voxterm a queue across sessions, similar to each coding agent's queue. Gists from several agent sessions would be spoken in turn.

area.quote: the `Gist:` lines were directly useful within the session for the first time. The thing that made them work was that voxterm was set to gist-only
